reason: Counterexample contract complete: edges of lengths 2^-n glued end to end give a locally finite connected gluing with compact convex cells; it is isometric to [0,2), the far endpoints form a Cauchy sequence with no limit (a limit in C_N would have coordinate at most 2-2^-N while p_k has coordinate 2-2^-k, so d(p,p_k)>=2^-(N+1) for k>N), closed balls are not compact, and the finite-shapes hypothesis fails. Level 3.
